name: WebGPU Voxel Ray Tracing Renderer
definition: A WebGPU compute shader-based ray tracer for voxel models that replaces a rasterizer. It casts rays per pixel, traverses a 3D voxel grid using DDA, applies directional lighting with diffuse shading, and generates hard shadows via shadow rays.
summary: A WebGPU compute shader-based ray tracer for voxel models that replaces rasterizers by implementing the entire rendering pipeline, including primary rays, diffuse shading, and shadow rays, within a single compute shader.
